sfx_review.note: 454 ms before the visual change; spectrogram shows no distinct swoosh shape over the music bed, and nothing visibly moves at 133.51 s.

pattern.description: After the cursor sets the Version 1 dropdown, the report table's content starts to dim/shift in tone as the app begins reloading the comparison; no camera move, the table stays in place.
pattern.why_premium: Leaving the real reload state on screen ties the narration ('the new May forecast we just created') to a visible system response, so the viewer reads cause and effect before the new numbers land.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.report-body', {opacity:0.4, filter:'brightness(0.6)', duration:0.25, ease:'none'}) right after the dropdown click; follow with a static spinner and a data-resolve step (see skeleton_resolve).
build_hint.remotion: const dim = interpolate(frame, [clickFrame, clickFrame + 6], [1, 0.4], {extrapolateLeft:'clamp', extrapolateRight:'clamp'}); apply as opacity on the table body. Linear, no spring.

notes: Filmstrip frames look nearly identical at thumbnail size; energy rises only in the last 4 frames, so this is probably the onset of the dim/loading state that e049-style reloads use. It may instead be a subtle text re-render. Cell numbers read from the end frame.
